title: commiphora edulis subsp. holosericea
intro: Commiphora edulis subsp. holosericea, commonly known as African myrrh, is a plant species within the Commiphora genus, characterized by its resinous sap. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful for wound healing, pain relief, and reducing fever. The therapeutic actions of African myrrh include anti-inflammatory, immunomodulatory, and antiseptic effects, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of African myrrh include triterpenoids, such as ferulic acid and myrrhenol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
